09 / Marketplace

JobRemotely — A curated remote job board

Vacancies with publicly disclosed salaries, verified by HR and free of spam.

Year
2026
Scope
Marketplace
  • 1280+
    Vitest tests
  • 3
    ATS sources — Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby
  • 7
    stages in the hiring pipeline

01 / Overview

JobRemotely is a job board that brings together HR-verified vacancies for remote engineers, designers and operators. It publishes only remote roles with disclosed salaries and moves candidates from application to offer through an automated flow.

02 / The problem

Remote job seekers get lost among spam listings, hidden salaries and recruiter messages. After applying, candidates never know which stage their application is in.

03 / Our approach

Vacancies are collected by scheduled scraping of the Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby ATS platforms, then filtered by salary and language. Application status is bound to a finite state machine: it changes only through permitted transitions, so candidates always see the right stage.

04 / The result

Candidates apply with one click and move transparently through skills testing, language verification, interviews and the offer stage. Admins see live funnel, throughput and stage-time metrics.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Curated board

    HR-verified, spam-free remote vacancies. Companies cannot see applicant identities (blind apply).

  • 02

    Multi-stage pipeline

    Application → screening → skills test → language → interview → offer → hiring.

  • 03

    AI tools

    Auto-fill a profile from a CV and generate cover letters.

  • 04

    Automated scraping

    Scheduled collection from ATS platforms with salary and language filters.

  • 05

    Admin analytics

    Funnel, throughput and stage-time metrics calculated from status events.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. State machine

    Application status changes only through allowed transitions; optimistic-concurrency conflicts are guarded with HTTP 409.

  2. Single source of truth

    Zod schemas are shared between API and frontend, and responses use typed ok() / err() envelopes.

  3. Separated background work

    Email, scraping, Telegram notifications and view counters run in a pg-boss worker outside the web process.
